fato_historico: 2022: Hurricane Ian makes landfall in Cayo Costa State Park, Florida as a category four hurricane, killing 169 and doing $113 billion in damage, becoming Florida's costliest hurricane and the deadliest in 89 years.
energia_do_dia: Today, your fiery spirit may feel drawn to reflect on the immense strength found within nature and the soul. Just as the winds clear the path for renewal, consider how your own inner storm can transform into a gentle breeze of wisdom. It is a good time to embrace your courage and nurture the warmth you bring to your community.
frase_do_dia: Even after the strongest winds, the sun rises to paint a brighter horizon.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of your natural intuition and personal power.
conselho: Focus on turning challenges into opportunities for profound personal growth today.
